Who we are
About Stripe
Stripe is a financial infrastructure platform for businesses. Millions of companies—from the world’s largest enterprises to the most ambitious startups—use Stripe to accept payments, grow their revenue, and accelerate new business opportunities. Our mission is to increase the GDP of the internet, and we have a staggering amount of work ahead. That means you have an unprecedented opportunity to put the global economy within everyone’s reach while doing the most important work of your career.

The infrastructure teams provide efficient and optimized infrastructure for Stripe to build secure, reliable and differentiated products, while enabling Stripe developers to achieve their highest potential.

Stripe makes it easy for any developer to access and manage the capabilities of the financial system while maintaining the least regulatory friction. We work to enable developers to have the most productive results of their entire career from the very first days they join Stripe through years of developing new systems and products.

As a Technical Program Manager in Infrastructure, you will drive programs that span multiple Stripe engineering organizations with a focus on improving the internal platforms that power all of our products.

In partnership with engineering and product management leaders, you will be responsible for planning, comms, and steering execution of large-scale technical programs that solve complex problems and enable product engineering teams across Stripe.

The ideal candidate will deliver exceptional results by implementing solutions that scale to the entire company, minimize disruption to product teams, and are aligned with other engineering efforts.

You’ll work closely with Service Infrastructure, which enables engineering teams at Stripe to build, ship, and operate products that are efficient, reliable, and performant. They are responsible for the frameworks, async platforms, and tooling used to write and operate all Stripe products.

They additionally drive company-wide refactoring and architectural improvements to ensure that products can scale, evolve, and continue to meet the needs of our customers.

Working with teams across the organization to understand pain points in their infrastructure usage to find common ideas and work to create solutions which span multiple domains
Define and produce high quality written proposals, communications and documentation.
Help define the frameworks, async platforms, and tooling used to write and operate all Stripe products
Partner with Engineering Managers, Tech Leads, Engineers and other Technical Program Managers to define, scope and drive large migration programs to conclusion.
Play a key part in shaping the technical design, predicting technical roadblocks by collaborating with engineers, and identifying trade-offs.
Develop, implement, and iterate on program management techniques, frameworks, and KPIs to achieve goals with well defined success criteria.
Elevate the execution muscle of engineering teams around you. Train them to be better at delivery where needed.
Help influence peers / stakeholders and build consensus while dealing with ambiguity
Leverage data and acquired knowledge to drive strategic decisions at an engineering leadership level.
Create widely circulated plans, driving consistency, clarity and building alignment across teams.
Operationalize and execute critical cross functional programs spanning Stripe engineering organizations

We’re looking for someone who meets the minimum requirements to be considered for the role. If you meet these requirements, you are encouraged to apply. The preferred qualifications are a bonus, not a requirement.

5+ years of software engineering, systems engineering and/or technical program management experience.
Experience with developer products or open source projects.
Experience in distributed systems, software libraries/frameworks, and service oriented architectures.
Excellent analytical skills; you digest complex information, can distill it and make recommendations and proposals.
You have a track record of providing program management during all phases of software development from kick-off to launch, demonstrating critical thinking, challenging the norms and thought leadership.
You have very strong written and verbal communication skills, building strong relationships with stakeholders, teams and senior leaders around the organization.
You can drive internal and external process improvements across multiple teams and functions and bring a wealth of experience, opinions, proposals and best practices.
Experience operating autonomously and rapidly and leading large-scale efforts across multiple teams and functions, with stakeholders in different disciplines across time zones.

You are comfortable working in a fast changing environment as the AI tool chain continues to evolve
Experience in core infrastructure such as database, cloud compute, networking, and services.
You are flexible in your approach to TPM and adapt to what your customers need
Background in technical program management specifically working in software infrastructure
You are comfortable working with geographically distributed teams
You are empathetic to customer needs but visionary enough to not just deliver a faster horse
You are excited about collaborating with teammates across Stripe’s organization
Working remotely at Stripe
A remote location is defined as being 35 miles (56 kilometers) or more from one of our offices. While you would be welcome to come into the office for team/business meetings, on-sites, meet-ups, and events, our expectation is you would regularly work from home rather than a Stripe office. Stripe does not cover the cost of relocating to a remote location. We encourage you to apply for roles that match the location where you currently live or plan to live.

The annual US base salary range for this role is $128,200 - $192,400. For sales roles, the range provided is the role’s On Target Earnings ("OTE") range, meaning that the range includes both the sales commissions/sales bonuses target and annual base salary for the role.

This salary range may be inclusive of several career levels at Stripe and will be narrowed during the interview process based on a number of factors, including the candidate’s experience, qualifications, and location.

Applicants interested in this role and who are not located in the US may request the annual salary range for their location during the interview process.
Additional benefits for this role may include: equity, company bonus or sales commissions/bonuses; 401(k) plan; medical, dental, and vision benefits; and wellness stipends.
We look forward to hearing from you
At Stripe, we're looking for people with passion, grit, and integrity. You're encouraged to apply even if your experience doesn't precisely match the job description. Your skills and passion will stand out—and set you apart—especially if your career has taken some extraordinary twists and turns. At Stripe, we welcome diverse perspectives and people who think rigorously and aren't afraid to challenge assumptions. Join us.

To evaluate your qualifications, your resume must clearly demonstrate how you meet the specialized experience described below. Your resume must not exceed two pages.

To ensure your qualifications can be fully evaluated, we recommend including the following information: Name, address, telephone number, email address; Job Title (if Federal Service, provide series and grade; if not in GS plan, provide GS equivalent grade); Relevant work experience—should include employer name, job title, start and end dates (month/year), the number of hours worked per week and descriptions that explain how you meet the required qualifications in the job announcement.

Education, certifications or licensures—If the job announcement requires any education, certifications or licensures, make sure to include the required information and any required documents like transcripts.

Your resume should contain enough information to make a valid determination that you fully meet experience requirements for each grade level you are applying to. If you do not provide enough information for us to determine your qualifications, you may be rated ineligible.

If you have volunteered your service through a National Service program (e.g., Peace Corps, Americorps), we encourage you to apply and include this experience on your resume. The GS-12 salary range starts at $89,508 per year.

If you are a new federal employee, your starting salary will likely be set at the Step 1 of the grade for which you are selected. To qualify, you must have at least one year of specialized experience equivalent to the GS-11 level or higher in the Federal service.

Specialized experience is defined as experience utilizing project management practices and tools to simultaneously manage multiple construction and/or repair and alteration projects in a real estate environment.

This experience must include: Managing projects (balancing scope/quality, schedule and budget) requiring the services of multiple disciplines (i.e., construction, design, IT, telecommunications, interior furnishings, etc.) from project initiation phase through financial closeout; Interpreting customer needs and developing them into actionable requirements; Developing, managing, and balancing project plans, budgets, and schedules; and Coordinating and facilitating decisions by managing multiple stakeholders.

Evaluates project progress, system effectiveness, and delivery quality, developing targeted tools and methods to track automation life-cycle milestones.
Coordinates the integration of automation workflows with inbound, outbound, and internal logistics processes across DLA Distribution, Disposition Services, and military services within SAP S/4, ECC, EWM, TM, and Fiori.
Represents the agency at meetings and conferences involving senior level personnel throughout Department of War (DoW), other government agencies and private industry.
Provides support in achieving DLA audit readiness goals and objectives to include direct support to audit readiness teams through the completion of specific tasks and deliverables.

Company Description
We are Olsson. We engineer and design solutions that improve the world around us. As a company, we promise to always be responsive, transparent, and focused on results – for our people, our clients, and our company.
We’re a people-centric firm, so it’s no surprise our greatest asset is our people. The impact this creates is an environment that encourages our people to grow and be creative with their talents. This approach builds a culture that is uniquely Olsson. It allows us to grow our people as we grow our business. This, in turn, creates a lasting impact on the world around us.
Job Description
Olsson offers its clients a full spectrum of water and wastewater services, including a complete line of planning, design, permitting, and construction phase services. Maintaining water quality is Olsson’s number one concern, and we are able to respond to a broad set of client demands in a timely and cost-effective manner.

As a Project Manager, you will be a lead project manager for our Water/Wastewater team, ensuring successful project deliverables and completion for complex and high-priority projects that may span across multiple teams.

You will also provide direction to the Water/Wastewater team and ensure quality execution of key projects that provide purposeful, high-quality solutions to successfully solve engineering and design needs.
As a Project Manager, you will take charge of supervising and nurturing the professional and technical growth of team members. Your emphasis on mentorship will contribute to a culture that values skill development, collaboration, and collective success. Together, we can make a positive impact on our communities and play a vital role in shaping the future of water infrastructure.

Develops project scopes, schedules, and budgets and tracks progress to manage the financial success of projects and ensure timely completion.
Manages complex contract negotiations.
Leads the execution of project plans by assembling and managing project teams, coordinating availability of internal resources, and assigning individual responsibilities ensuring technical skills, capabilities, and expertise align with project objectives.
Serves as primary liaison between all parties involved in a project.
Monitors progress and measures project performance, ensuring deliverables fall within established scope, schedule, and budget.
Manages change requests, executes risk management techniques, and implements strategies to minimize negative financial impact to the project.
Coordinates detailed reviews of technical work to ensure high-quality work is being performed and the terms, conditions, and specifications outlined in the project contract are being fulfilled.
Maintains an ongoing positive relationship with clients and focuses on exceptional client service to secure future work.
Documents all project deliverables and maintains comprehensive records including correspondence, design plans, and other project related files.
Mentors and supervises staff within the team on project management best practices utilizing Olsson Project Management programs and other project support services resources.

Working collaboratively with others.
Having ownership in the work you do.
Using your talents to positively affect communities.

Strong communication skills.

Proven track record in meeting and exceeding client expectations through project management activities.

We are seeking a highly skilled Principal Technical Program Manager (TPM) to lead large, complex, cross-functional engineering programs supporting Public Sector. This is a senior individual-contributor role requiring strong technical depth, strategic program leadership, and the ability to communicate clearly at the VP/SVP/EVP level.

The Principal TPM must maintain working fluency in cloud architecture, distributed systems design, large-scale enterprise integration patterns, data flows, APIs/services, network engineering fundamentals, security, reliability, and modern SDLC/DevOps practices.

The Principal TPM converts business strategy into predictable engineering delivery, drives cross-value-stream alignment, manages critical dependencies and risks, and ensures executive stakeholders receive concise, decision-ready updates.

Location
This is a remote opportunity for candidates located anywhere in the U.S.

Lead the end-to-end lifecycle of large, complex, multi-team engineering programs, ensuring program structure, delivery rhythms, and engineering outcomes are clear and predictable.
Define and track performance metrics tied to engineering execution, program health, and SLAs with business and product stakeholders.
Develop and maintain engineering-aligned roadmaps, integrated timelines, dependency maps, budgets, and risk mitigation plans.
Build and lead program governance for executives, synthesizing engineering progress, risks, and technical trade-offs into clear, decision-oriented updates.
Implement best practices in engineering program governance, dependency management, cross-team risk visibility, SDLC alignment, and change management.
Foster a culture of accountability, technical excellence, and delivery predictability across engineering teams and partner groups.
Partner with finance, engineering, and product to monitor capital/opex, capacity utilization, and resource allocation across internal teams and vendors.
Report on program status including engineering risks, dependencies, integration concerns, and mitigation paths to senior leadership and key stakeholders.
Coordinate engineering planning cycles (roadmap planning, PI planning, quarterly commitments) and ensure backlogs are prioritized, estimated, and aligned with program objectives.
Contribute to strategic planning and partner across Product, Engineering, Architecture, and Operations to ensure engineering readiness for launches and major releases.

What We Look For in a Candidate

Bachelor’s degree in a technical field or equivalent experience; advanced degree is a plus.
12–15+ years of experience leading large-scale technical or engineering programs within complex, matrixed technology organizations.
Strong technical fluency in architecture, system design, APIs/services, data flows, and SDLC/DevOps.
Proven ability to communicate clearly and influence at the VP/SVP/EVP level—distilling complex engineering issues, risks, and trade-offs into concise recommendations.
Demonstrated experience managing engineering dependencies, sequencing across multiple teams, and driving outcomes across software and/or network domains.
Strong ability to navigate ambiguity, resolve cross-team conflicts, and turn strategy into structured engineering execution plans.
Exceptional stakeholder engagement and relationship-building skills across Product, Engineering, Architecture, Operations, and Finance.
High urgency, accountability, and operational rigor; sets high standards for clarity, delivery predictability, and tooling hygiene. PMP/PMI, Agile/SAFe, or Lean Six Sigma certifications are a plus.

Under the general direction of the Front Line Manager or Supervisory Principal Avionics Inspector, assists the Partial Program Manager (Avionics), in accomplishing the following duties: A. Technical Administration.

Within assigned technical program, assures on a continuing basis that organizations are properly and adequately organized, staffed, and equipped; have and conduct an adequate training program, including an acceptable record keeping system; and have facilities and procedures that meet all regulatory requirements.

Regularly visits the organization's stations and other offices to maintain contact with their management officials; coordinates with the principal inspector for correction of any deficiencies/discrepancies. Coordinates Minimum Equipment List (MEL) approvals with the principal operations inspector. Takes enforcement action in instances of noncompliance with the MEL. Conducts enforcement investigations and prepares final reports and recommendations on disposition.

Performs the emergency suspension of certificates or cancellations of operations specifications. Conducts or directs the reexamination of certificated airmen or recertification of an operator or agency. Conducts investigations of public complaints, congressional inquiries, and aircraft incidents and accidents.

Provides verbal and/or written technical assistance to legal counsel, testifies at court trials and formal hearings, and gives depositions. Coordinates with geographic inspectors for the accomplishment of nonroutine air carrier surveillance. B. Certification.

The inspector is responsible for initial and ongoing certification of air carriers, aircraft, airmen, and air agencies. Makes recommendations on the appointment of designees.

Evaluates requests to operate under conditions not previously specified in the maintenance portion of the operations specifications and approves or disapproves requests and provides additional conditions and limitations as needed.

Provides guidance to the assigned air carrier in the development of required maintenance manuals and record keeping systems. Reviews and determines adequacy of manuals associated with the air carrier's maintenance programs and revisions thereto.

Assures that manuals and revisions comply with regulatory requirements, prescribe safe practices, and furnish clear and specific instructions governing maintenance programs. Approves operations specifications and amendments thereto.

Determines if the maintenance facilities being established or contract arrangements entered into by air carriers for the purpose of overhaul work, major repairs, alterations, and other maintenance are satisfactory. Reviews changes and negotiates with air carrier management to resolve problems.

Determines if overhaul and inspection time limitations warrant revision. Evaluates an operator's proposed reliability programs for compliance with national policies. Advises operator of deficiencies and required changes. Approves/disapproves reliability programs.

Determines if the air carrier's training program meets the requirements of the Code of Federal Regulations (CFR), is compatible with the maintenance program, is properly organized and effectively conducted, and results in trained and competent personnel. Directs or participates in proving flight evaluations to determine compliance with the CFRs.

Recommends changes that will be required prior to approval. C. Surveillance. Directs and/or performs the inspection and surveillance of the air carrier's continuous airworthiness maintenance program.

Monitors all phases of the air carrier's maintenance operation, including the following: maintenance, engineering, quality control, production control, training, and reliability programs. Analyzes trends to detect a deterioration in the maintenance program. May be assigned other duties and responsibilities.

Applicants not requiring valid second-class medical certificates who are tentatively selected will be required to: Provide documentation from a board-certified physician certifying that they meet the minimal medical requirements; or Individuals who do not meet the minimum medical requirements but who are otherwise qualified will receive an individualized assessment to determine whether they can perform the essential functions of the position.

Avionics maintenance experience on aircraft of more than 12,500 pounds maximum certificated takeoff weight. 3. Aircraft avionics work experience (which could include supervision or auditing) in a repair station; air carrier repair facility; military repair facility; or local, state, or Federal governmental agency within the last 3 years.

Specialized experience is experience that has equipped you with the particular knowledge, skills, and abilities to perform successfully the duties of the position. The Program Manager directs an integrated Service Area resource management program supporting multiple Service Units across the Air Traffic Organization (ATO).

Manages teams through subordinate managers in workforce planning, organizational performance, employee development, staffing resource allocation, financial resource management, and organizational support functions necessary to accomplish Service Area operational objectives.

Coordinates Service Area administrative resource management activities with internal and external organizations concerning pay administration, merit promotion, Congressional inquiries, Freedom of Information Act (FOIA) requests, and other organizational support functions affecting Service Area operations.

The work includes complex projects/programs based on the objectives.

Directs the administration of training and employee development programs, including Federal Aviation Administration (FAA) Academy quota allocation, technical training, leadership development, safety training, certification tracking, and career progression planning to ensure workforce readiness and compliance with Agency requirements.

Evaluates the interrelationships of funding and resource priorities to identify shortfalls and to direct and oversee the preparation of resource appeals. Coordinates financial analysis and cost management efforts using experience applying a detailed technical knowledge of FAA and the ATO appropriations, policies, and procedures.

Applies detailed knowledge of the technical aspect of the work directed, providing strategic oversight of Service Area performance management and employees, employee recognition, and organizational effectiveness programs to improve workforce performance, mission and operational readiness, and workforce capabilities.

Plans, directs, and integrates administrative programs governing workforce planning, staffing allocations, organizational structure, organizational performance, employee development, and training to ensure organizational resources are aligned with Service Area mission requirements.

Applies a detailed knowledge of budget, human resource management and other administrative policies and procedures.

Managerial duties typically affect managers and employees for more than one organizational unit/project/program, and include: strategic planning; communicating the organization's vision and objectives; setting priorities; assigning tasks and responsibilities; monitoring and evaluating performance of organizational units, managers, and employees; coaching and developing staff and organizational capabilities; approving leave; and taking or approving corrective/disciplinary actions as appropriate.

Contacts are routinely internal and external to the Service Center. Internal contacts are with subordinates, peers, and higher level management to discuss the statuses and results of projects/programs and plan position management, staffing levels allocations and organizational structure for the future.

May represent the Mission Support Services (AJV), ATO, or the FAA externally as a primary point of contact for policies/ procedures or other project/program purposes. Has the authority, within guidelines, to make commitments for the major subdivision, to establish new policies/procedures, and to make exceptions.

Work is typically governed by established policies, procedures and mission objectives which leave considerable room for discretion. Provides guidance to subordinate managers and employees for preventing and resolving problems without the intervention of higher level management except where ATO or FAA-wide interests are at stake.

Develops and approves solutions to current and anticipated problems which cross organizational lines and disciplines. May participate in developing solutions to FAA-wide problems involving resource management issues.
Candidates must have one year (52 weeks) of specialized experience equivalent to the (FV-J or FG/GS14) level that is typically in or related to the line of work of the position to be filled and which has equipped the applicant with the particular knowledge, skills, and abilities to perform successfully the work of the position to be filled.

WARUM WIR? Projektentwicklung ist für uns kein standardisierter Ablauf.
Sondern ein Feld, in dem man breit denken, Verantwortung übernehmen und sich immer wieder neu auf Projekte, Phasen und Rahmenbedingungen einstellen muss.
Genau dafür suchen wir Dich - Ob frühe Ideenphase oder fortgeschrittene Projektentwicklung:
In der Bauherrenvertretung als Dienstleistung steuerst du Projekte ganzheitlich, bist Sparringspartner für den Bauherrn, triffst Entscheidungen, führst Teams – und behältst dabei Wirtschaftlichkeit, Qualität und Strategie im Blick.
Wer wir sind – KVL Projektentwicklung Plus
Die KVL Projektentwicklung Plus GmbH ist auf ganzheitliche Projektentwicklung und Bauherrenvertretung spezialisiert. Wir führen und begleiten Immobilienprojekte von der ersten Idee bis zur Umsetzung – strategisch, wirtschaftlich und technisch.
Wir verstehen Projektentwicklung als einen interdisziplinären und partnerschaftlichen Prozess, in dem wirtschaftliche, technische, gestalterische und strategische Fragestellungen zusammengeführt werden.
Wir arbeiten standortübergreifend in Berlin und München und organisieren unsere Projekte bewusst in interdisziplinären Teams. Je nach Projektphase und Aufgabenstellung denken wir breit, reagieren flexibel und stellen für jedes Projekt das passende Team zusammen.

Encourages pharmacy activities that support the pharmacy mission using established goals and objectives to make critical decisions. Nebius is leading a new era in cloud infrastructure for the global AI economy. We are building a full-stack AI cloud platform that supports developers and enterprises from data and model training through to production deployment, without the cost and complexity of building large in-house AI/ML infrastructure.
Built by engineers, for engineers. From large-scale GPU orchestration to inference optimization, we own the hard problems across compute, storage, networking and applied AI.

We are looking for a Technical Program Manager to own the operational readiness and ongoing health of our fleet of Data Centers, both COLO and BTS sites.

In this role you will be the single point of accountability for ensuring each site runs as expected — SLAs met, maintenance executed on schedule, and audits passed — across a growing portfolio of landlord-operated and purpose-built facilities.

You will operate as the primary interface between Nebius and our data center landlords and operators, and you will partner closely with the Nebius IT team to translate site-level operations into reliable infrastructure for our customers.
This is an individual contributor position for someone who is equally comfortable in a contractual SLA review, a maintenance window planning call, and a physical site audit. You will define the mechanisms that keep our sites accountable and surface risk before it becomes an incident.

Own the operational health of Nebius COLO and BTS sites, ensuring each facility runs to expectation across power, cooling, space, connectivity, security, and environmental controls.
Track, monitor, and enforce SLA compliance across landlords and colocation providers; identify breaches, drive remediation, and hold providers accountable to contractual commitments.
Manage and coordinate site maintenance schedules — preventive and corrective — including planning and approving maintenance windows, reviewing Methods of Procedure (MOPs), and minimizing risk to live workloads.
Plan and drive site audits covering compliance, capacity, power/cooling performance, physical security, and safety; track findings to closure.
Serve as the primary day-to-day interface with data center landlords and operators, managing the operational relationship, escalations, and coordination of on-site activity.
Partner closely with the Nebius IT team on deployments, capacity planning, incident response, and change management at each site.
Build reporting mechanisms and dashboards that give leadership clear visibility into site health, SLA performance, maintenance status, and open risk across the portfolio.
Lead incident coordination and post-incident follow-up, including root cause analysis and corrective action tracking with landlords and internal teams.
Track and manage contractual operational obligations, deliverables, and timelines across multiple sites and providers simultaneously.

The Data Center team is responsible for the physical infrastructure that underpins Nebius' AI cloud. We manage the full lifecycle of our COLO and BTS footprint — from bringing new capacity online to keeping live sites running reliably at scale. We work at the intersection of facilities operations, vendor management, and IT infrastructure, and we move fast because our customers' AI workloads depend on the reliability we deliver.

In this role, you will drive vulnerability intake, triage, remediation, and reporting across our bug bounty program, our Google Cloud Platform (GCP) infrastructure, source code hosted on GitHub, and a broad portfolio of third-party SaaS services.

You will partner closely with platform engineering, product engineering, SRE, security, IT, legal, and vendor management to make sure vulnerabilities are found fast, triaged accurately, and closed within SLA — and that leadership always has a clear, current picture of the organization's risk posture.The ideal candidate uses AI and automation aggressively to scale themselves, but understands that the core value is clarity, tradeoffs, and execution, not just tooling.

Program Ownership: Own and continuously improve the vulnerability management program, including intake, severity scoring (CVSS/risk-based), SLA definition, and remediation tracking across all asset types.
Bug Bounty Operations: Manage the triage/payouts/rewards workflow, and report on program health and trends.
Cloud Remediation (GCP): Drive remediation of vulnerabilities found in GCP infrastructure — IAM, networking, Compute/GKE, storage, and logging/monitoring configuration — by partnering with security, cloud, and platform engineering teams.
Code & Supply Chain Security: Coordinate remediation of vulnerabilities surfaced through SAST/DAST/SCA tooling (Wiz Code, Snyk, Dependabot, code scanning, secret scanning) across engineering repos, including dependency and supply-chain risk.
SaaS Vendor Risk: Build and manage the process for assessing and tracking security posture across third-party SaaS applications.
Escalation & Exceptions: Define and enforce escalation paths for overdue or critical/high-severity findings, including risk acceptance and exception processes with appropriate sign-off.
Cross-Team Accountability: Partner with engineering managers and tech leads to embed remediation work into sprint planning and hold teams accountable to remediation SLAs.
Reporting & Alerting: Establish and maintain a single source of truth for vulnerability status, aging, SLA compliance, and risk trends, with dashboards for engineering leadership, security leadership, and executives.
Audit & Compliance Support: Support audit and compliance efforts (SOC 2, ISO 27001, customer security questionnaires) by keeping vulnerability management evidence and metrics audit-ready.
Process & Automation: Drive process improvements and automation to reduce manual triage effort and improve time-to-remediation across all vulnerability sources.

Experience: 4–6+ years of experience in technical program management, security program management, or security operations, with direct ownership of a vulnerability management or application security program.
Bug Bounty Expertise: Hands-on experience running a bug bounty program (e.g., HackerOne, Bugcrowd, Intigriti), including triage and payout workflows.
Cloud Security Knowledge (GCP): Working knowledge of GCP security fundamentals: IAM, VPC/networking, Security Command Center, Cloud Logging/Monitoring, and common cloud misconfiguration risks.
Code Security Familiarity: Familiarity with GitHub-based development workflows and code security tooling (Wiz Code, Dependabot, SAST/DAST/SCA tools such as Snyk, Semgrep, or CodeQL).
Risk Prioritization: Strong grasp of vulnerability scoring frameworks (CVSS) and risk-based prioritization.
Communication: Excellent cross-functional communication skills — able to translate technical vulnerability data into business risk for executive audiences and hold engineering teams accountable without owning the code themselves.
Reporting Tools: Proven ability to build reporting/dashboards (e.g., Linear, Jira, ServiceNow, Tableau, Looker) that give leadership real-time visibility into program health.
Compliance Awareness: Experience supporting compliance frameworks such as SOC 2, ISO 27001, PCI-DSS, or FedRAMP.

Systems Thinking: The ability to see the “big picture” and understand how vulnerability management decisions impact the entire stack — cloud, code, and vendor ecosystem alike.
Technical Influence: The ability to drive alignment across engineering and security through expertise and collaboration rather than direct authority.
Autonomy: Comfortable owning a program end to end and driving outcomes with minimal oversight.
Bias for Action: A track record of closing the gap between finding a vulnerability and actually getting it fixed.

We are seeking a Senior Science Program Manager to serve as a key architect of our international scientific and clinical research portfolio in the United Arab Emirates (UAE). You will not only direct the execution of complex, cross-functional science and clinical initiatives but also shape the strategic collaboration roadmap that aligns our research investments with our long-term commercial and healthcare positioning in the UAE and beyond.
This is a remote role based in the U.S with a strong preference for candidates based on the East Coast (Eastern Time). Oura’s remote employees in major cities like Boston, DC, and New York occasionally gather informally at local co-working locations.

Orchestrate a Strategic Research Portfolio: Define the governance and roadmap for an international research portfolio, ensuring every study and collaboration is strategically aligned with Oura’s evidence-based growth objectives.
Drive Scientific Governance: Establish the framework for rigorous, compliant research delivery. You will guide and evolve our operational processes into scalable systems that elevate the quality and pace of our scientific pipeline as we scale.
Architect Cross-Functional Integration: Serve as the strategic hub between Health Science, Product, Regulatory, and external global partners. You will influence decision-making by translating complex scientific goals into clear, actionable business strategies.
Lead Dissemination and Impact: Own the strategic dissemination plan (publications, abstracts, clinical validation), ensuring our research milestones successfully support our brand authority and regulatory trajectory.
Cultivate Global Partnerships: Proactively identify and cultivate high impact research partnerships in the region, managing external CROs and academic collaborators to ensure they serve as an extension of Oura’s scientific vision.
Travel to the UAE and other regional locations to form trusted collaborative relationships with a complex set of partner institutions ranging from local hospital systems, government entities, and academic/scientific partners.

s.h: We would love to consider you for this role if you have
s.t:
6+ years of program or project management experience in scientific, clinical, or health research, including owning studies end to end.
An advanced degree (MS or PhD) in a health, life-science, or related field, or equivalent experience.
A blend of strategic thinking and robust execution: able to set the direction of research collaborations and then lead the delivery amid ambiguity.
Strong working knowledge of the human and clinical research study lifecycle (protocol design and development, IRB/ethics, data collection, and closure) and what rigorous, compliant execution requires.
Experience directing complex, cross-functional work across multiple internal teams and external partners (CROs, sites, PIs), ideally across regions and time zones.
Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to translate between scientific, technical, product, and partner audiences.
Ability to travel to the UAE approximately for onsite visits to support study execution and partner collaboration (~10-15% travel, including international transit)

Prior experience working on and/or leading research initiatives in the United Arab Emirates (UAE)
Proficiency in Arabic (spoken and written)

SoFi is seeking a highly motivated, strategic, and detail-oriented Direct Mail Project Manager who thrives in a fast-paced, data-driven environment. This role is responsible for driving the operational execution of SoFi's Direct Mail program by partnering closely with Marketing Data Science Marketing Data Science with precision and efficiency.
This is not a traditional project management role. Success requires someone who understands campaign strategy, can independently translate business discussions into actionable execution plans, exercises sound judgment in a fast-moving environment, and proactively identifies opportunities to improve how we operate as the Direct Mail program continues to scale.
The ideal candidate is equally comfortable managing cross-functional initiatives, optimizing operational processes, leveraging AI-enabled workflows, and maintaining exceptional attention to detail across every stage of campaign execution.

s.h: This role owns four core areas of responsibility
s.t:
Project Management of Campaign Execution
Own end-to-end project management for monthly Direct Mail campaigns, serving as the primary project manager for all campaign-related data operations and ensuring schedules, mail matrix, milestones, dependencies, and deliverables are executed on time.
Partner closely Marketing Data Science to build campaign execution schedules that align with business priorities, targeting strategies, and production timelines.
Create, manage, and continuously refine project plans and JIRA tickets throughout the campaign lifecycle, ensuring work is accurately scoped, prioritized, quality checked, and completed before handoff.
Lead cross-functional execution by translating business discussions into real-time updates to project plans, JIRA tickets, timelines, and stakeholder priorities, ensuring teams remain aligned as campaign requirements evolve.
Drive cross-functional accountability by coordinating approvals, tracking deliverables, identifying risks, and ensuring teams remain aligned throughout campaign execution.
Operational Excellence & Continuous Iterations for Improvement
Continuously evaluate campaign operations to identify risks, process gaps, and opportunities to improve efficiency, scalability, and execution quality.
Partner with Marketing Data Science and external vendors to optimize workflows, scheduling and campaign execution as program complexity grows.
Develop, document, and maintain SOPs, DACIs, and other operational documentation to standardize and support direct mail execution.
Help evolve the Direct Mail operating model by implementing scalable solutions, managing Agency of Record assignments, and driving operational consistency across campaign workstreams.
Champion operational innovation by continuously evaluating and adopting new technologies, AI capabilities, and automation solutions that simplify processes, reduce manual effort, and enable the Direct Mail program to scale efficiently while maintaining executional excellence.
Campaign Operations, Reporting & Quality Assurance
Leverage campaign and operational data insights to identify trends, resolve process gaps, and partner with Marketing Data Science to continuously improve campaign processes and operational accuracy.
Own the creation, maintenance, and quality control of campaign planning documentation, reporting, and large-scale mail matrices, ensuring data integrity, accuracy, and readiness for campaign execution.
Provide internal stakeholders and external vendors with campaign requirements for seven plus products including audience strategy unique by product, mail quantities, cell codes, drop dates, and timelines, and perform quality assurance across all campaign deliverables before launch.
Maintain recurring reports, Direct Mail performance dashboards, attribution reporting, and performance actuals, delivering accurate campaign insights that support decision-making across products and feed into campaign planning test and learn loop.
AI-Enabled Workflows
Leverage AI tools to streamline project management, documentation, reporting, and repetitive operational workflows, improving efficiency while maintaining accuracy and quality.
Stay current on evolving AI technologies and spearhead recommendations that enhance team productivity and execution quality to efficiently and effectively support program growth.
Champion thoughtful adoption of AI-enabled workflows to continue iterating and improving the Direct Mail program while maintaining appropriate oversight and a high standard of operational excellence.
What Will Make You Successful
Strategic thinker with the ability to translate business discussions into actionable execution plans, exercising sound judgment and knowing when to collaborate or escalate.
Highly organized with exceptional attention to detail, capable of managing multiple complex initiatives while adapting priorities in a fast-paced, evolving environment.
Analytical and naturally curious, using campaign data to identify trends, uncover opportunities, and recommend scalable process improvements.
Exceptional written and verbal communication skills, with a proven ability to facilitate complex, technical meetings, align cross-functional stakeholders, navigate competing priorities, and drive clear decisions and next steps.
Demonstrates ownership, accountability, and a continuous improvement mindset, proactively driving high-quality outcomes and supporting team success.
Embraces AI and emerging technologies as productivity tools, identifying opportunities to improve workflows and operational efficiency.
Thrives in a dynamic environment where priorities, timelines, and business needs frequently evolve, demonstrating flexibility, resilience, and the ability to pivot quickly while keeping projects on track.

Bachelor's degree with 5+ years of project management experience, preferably supporting direct mail or other marketing campaigns within financial services or another highly regulated industry.
Experience partnering with cross-functional teams to execute complex, multi-channel campaigns and operational initiatives.
Experience using project management platforms (e.g., JIRA) to manage complex, cross-functional initiatives.
Experience leveraging AI tools to improve productivity, documentation, and operational workflows.
Advanced proficiency in Excel, Google Workspace (particularly Google Sheets), and reporting tools such as Tableau

Here at The Exploration Company, we are developing, producing, and operating Nyx, a modular and reusable space orbital vehicle that can eventually be refuelled in orbit and that can carry cargo - and potentially humans in the longer run.
Storm is TEC’s high-performance liquid rocket engine program, developed to support next-generation launch and space transportation applications. The Storm development strategy relies heavily on ground testing, from early development models to qualification and acceptance campaigns. The engine test bench is a critical enabler of the program, and its on-time delivery is essential to maintain the Storm development schedule.
As Storm Engine Test Bench Program Manager, you are responsible for driving the on-time delivery of the Storm engine test bench development program.

You will ensure execution discipline across the bench development workstream: integrating schedules, tracking deliverables, coordinating stakeholders and suppliers, anticipating blockers, and escalating decisions to keep the program on track.

In addition, you will act as the primary point of contact for identifying and securing a suitable test bench location, coordinating the site selection process with internal stakeholders and external parties.

Program planning and delivery (schedule, scope, cost tracking)
Build, maintain, and continuously improve the integrated test bench delivery plan (design maturity gates, procurement lead times, manufacturing, installation, integration, and commissioning support activities).
Own the critical path , dependencies, and milestone readiness criteria (from a delivery perspective).
Track progress, identify schedule threats early, and drive recovery plans (re-sequencing, parallelization, expediting, resourcing proposals).
Maintain program routines (weekly reviews, action tracking, decision logs) to ensure execution discipline.
Cross-functional coordination and communication
Animate weekly/monthly routines: bench program reviews, schedule reviews, and interface meetings
Ensure alignment between propulsion engineering, test engineering, facilities/infrastructure, procurement, quality, and site teams
Prepare concise reporting for program leadership: status, risks, mitigation, upcoming decisions, and milestone readiness
Coordinate preparation of key internal reviews (bench concept reviews, design/package readiness, delivery readiness checkpoints)
Test bench location identification and site selection (point of contact)
Act as the single point of contact to identify, assess, and secure a test bench location aligned with the Storm schedule and development needs.
Coordinate the site selection process (timeline, stakeholder alignment, decision gates, and documentation) and ensure decisions are taken in time to protect the critical path.
With support from the engineering team (who define requirements and technical needs), consolidate the test site needs impacting the choice of location and translate them into:
A practical location assessment checklist (capabilities, utilities, access, constraints)
A comparison of candidate sites (schedule, cost, readiness, risks)
Clear decision packages for leadership (trade-offs, recommended option, fallback plans)
Coordinate interfaces with external stakeholders as needed (site operators, landlords/partners, utilities, local service providers), in alignment with internal owners.
Procurement and supplier coordination
Coordinate long-lead procurement tracking
Support supplier selection and onboarding (RFI/RFQ process coordination, delivery tracking, expediting)
Monitor supplier performance and ensure timely resolution of delivery issues, NCR handling coordination, and logistics readiness
Ensure documentation deliverables from suppliers are collected and integrated
Integration and commissioning readiness support
Ensure prerequisites for integration/commissioning are planned and tracked: procedures availability, resources, tooling, spares, training needs and documentation readiness (owned by responsible teams)
Track open points, coordinate closure plans, and ensure readiness evidence is available for management decisions.
Support lessons-learned capture and incorporation into the next iterations of bench capability
What we would like to see from you
Master’s degree (or equivalent) in Aerospace Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Systems Engineering, or similar
Significant experience delivering complex test infrastructure or propulsion tests programs
Proven program management experience (planning, budgeting, risk, suppliers)
Strong understanding of propulsion testing, cryogenic systems, and hazardous operations
Experience with LOX/methane engine testing or cryogenic facilities
Familiarity with European space programs and standards (e.g. ECSS, ESA‑style reviews)
Experience with regulated industrial sites, permitting, or environmental compliance
Background in high‑cadence test operations
Ability to lead cross‑functional teams and make sound technical and operational decisions
Strong ownership and delivery mindset
Systems‑level thinking and interface management
Calm decision‑making during high‑pressure test activities
Strong documentation and reporting discipline
Fluent in English; French or German is a plus.

We’re Agile - we make decisions fast whilst keeping our goals and systems in mind

### **Your Purpose** ###
As the Assistant HUB Manager, you will play a vital role in elevating our guests- experiences by managing photo and video services onboard. Your mission is to support the HUB Manager in overseeing daily operations, driving sales, and fostering a dynamic team environment. You-ll contribute to preserving memorable moments for our guests while upholding the highest standards of service excellence.

Your leadership and sales expertise will directly enhance the success of our onboard photo and video services. By managing a motivated team, achieving sales targets, and ensuring operational efficiency, you-ll help create unforgettable experiences for our guests. Your customer-focused approach will ensure each guest interaction is personalized and professional, reinforcing our brand-s commitment to exceptional service.
### **Your Journey So Far** ###

1. Minimum three years of proven experience in a similar role, such as Assistant HUB Manager, Assistant Photo Manager.
2. Ship experience in a similar role.
3. Demonstrated sales expertise with a strong track record in a customer-facing role, ideally within retail or hospitality.
4. Experience managing teams and achieving sales targets, with the ability to inspire and guide others.
5. Proficiency in English (at least a b2 level), with excellent communication and interpersonal skills.
6. Familiarity with photo and video sales is a significant advantage, as is knowledge of digital editing tools and equipment.
### **Your Essentials** ###

Zurich Insurance is on an exciting journey to become a truly customer led organization.
Zurich-s Group Customer Office is playing a pivotal role on that journey and is involved in a broad range of activities - working with all our regions and markets across the globe to shape the customer agenda.
To support this effort, we are looking for a passionate, data-driven, and innovative insights expert to join our Customer, Market & Brand Insights team.

This role is paramount in evaluating our brand health and customer experience through our continuous Global Brand tracking study and Relationship NPS studies that inform decision making across 20+ markets and at every level of the business.

These fundamental studies enable us to diagnose brand perceptions and deep dive into the customer experience (CX) shaping future strategies and improving how we deliver against customer needs.

Working closely with local markets, as well as regional management and other Group functions, this role will include planning, delivery and evolving these tools to ensure data-based insights are generated to influence business decisions and actions.

As the volume and volume and complexity of data grows, we-re evolving how we work - embracing AI tools to accelerate data processing and transform how insight is presented to the business. Our intention is to spend less time on production and more time on interpretation, implementation and communication that drives action.
Reporting to the Head of Global Brand Tracking & NPS, the candidate-s key responsibilities will focus on consistently delivering these important insights platforms, so they evolve with the business needs and drive change.

* Act as customer champion, raising awareness, providing guidance and training to the organization on key dimensions and insights of our program to drive actions.
* Take ownership of the two continuous global studies and ad hoc retail RNPS studies ensuring smooth project management and delivery of robust and relevant data and KPIs into the business.
* Apply AI and emerging technology to insight work to increase efficiency in data processing, synthesis and reporting, enabling shaper focus on interpretation, narrative and business implication.
* Define, evolve and conduct global studies, coordinating between multitude of markets and partnering with the respective agency.
* Analyze feedback, derive insight, report and present to stakeholders across the organization, including senior management at global, regional and local level.
* Drive the combination of data sources to strengthen relevance to decision making and impact on performance e.g. correlation analysis linking customer experience with financials.
* Ensure programs are technically strong and appropriate from questionnaire development, sample, weighting rules, and data uploads building confidence in the tool-s robustness.
* Translate analytic insights into concrete actionable recommendations, drawing conclusions for business improvement and influencing strategy effectively, including workshop facilitation.
* Maintain and promote our data hosting platform to democratize insights across the business.
* Manage external research agencies and budgets.
* Input support to Senior Insight Manager in identifying, communicating and activating insights.
* Keep up with best practice in the field and transfer relevant topics into Zurich-s programs.
Work location is Zurich with travel potentially required up to 10%

* Bachelor-s or master-s degree (e.g., in business studies/administration, research, data science, psychology, behaviour science, customer or change management), 5+ years of experience in managing insights to actions programs.
* Expertise in managing customer research as part of an in-house customer insight team or as part of a consulting practice, ideally coupled with solid expertise in NPS and/or brand tracking methodology.
* A curiosity and experience exploring or applying AI tools in a research/insight context (e.g. verbatim analysis, automated reporting, cross market synthesis).
* Passionate and curious about data analysis & identifying insights to facilitate action planning.
* Program management and coordination skills to build and drive studies across 19+ markets including managing study preparation and execution (e.g. study set up and design, sampling strategy definition, execution, reporting), driving alignment between markets and ensuring global study framework is applied and adhered to.
* Ability to work with larger sets of data (Excel, SPSS) to provide additional/ad-hoc analysis (creating cuts of data based on different stakeholder requirements in addition to agency results packs).
* Experience in working with markets across the globe as well as ability to build and manage relationships across different cultural clusters.
* Strong analytical, (insights) writing/communications as well as workshop facilitation skills.
* Ability to guide virtual teams, e.g., establish and run global VOC community.
* Solid knowledge of insurance market, operations, products and services.
* Working language is primarily English.

With a strong focus on intralogistics and SAP-enabled initiatives such as SAP EWM, you will translate warehouse operations, material flows and logistics requirements into sustainable digital solutions.
Working closely with manufacturing, logistics, supply chain and IT organizations, you will be responsible for project governance, execution and value delivery. You will supervise cutover, migration, go-live and hypercare activities, while ensuring successful process implementation, organizational change and user adoption.
Through your structured, pragmatic and results-oriented approach, you will act as a trusted partner for Ops Heads, IT leads and project sponsors. You will help accelerate Accelleron's digitalization journey, strengthen operational performance and enable sustainable business growth across the value chain.
You will join the Supply & Value Chain Excellence organization in Baden, reporting to the Team Lead Value Chain Digitalization, and collaborate closely with business leadership, IT and technical experts across our value chain.

Lead complex Manufacturing and Supply Chain digitalization projects from concept through go-live and stabilization.

Support strategic digitalization initiatives and contribute to Accelleron's long-term Manufacturing and Supply Chain development.

8+ years of experience leading complex projects in Manufacturing, Supply Chain, Operations or Digital Transformation, with excellent project and stakeholder management skills and a proven track record of successful delivery in a manufacturing environment.
Good understanding of manufacturing, logistics and supply chain processes; experience in intralogistics or warehouse operations is a strong advantage.
Experience with SAP-enabled transformation initiatives; exposure to SAP EWM or warehouse management solutions is beneficial but not mandatory.

s.h: Was dich in der Rolle als Projektmanager:in erwartet
s.t:
Du begleitest Arztpraxen vom ersten Tag an - von der technischen Einrichtung über die Schulung des Praxisteams bis zur aktiven Betreuung in den ersten Wochen nach dem Go-live. Dabei übernimmst du echte Verantwortung: Du managst deine Projekte eigenständig, bist erste Ansprechperson für deine Kunden und sorgst dafür, dass der Wechsel zu Nelly reibungslos klappt. Kein Tag ist wie der andere – du bist nah an den Menschen, nah am Produkt und siehst direkt, was deine Arbeit bewirkt.
Über Nelly
Wir bauen das AI-Driven Financial Operating System für das europäische Gesundheitswesen und lösen so die größten Herausforderungen für Patient:innen und Praxen. Damit schaffen wir, was keine Bank oder Softwareplattform bewältigen kann.

Unsere All-In-One Plattform verwandelt chaotische administrative Prozesse in intelligente, automatisierte Arbeitsabläufe, von der Patientenbetreuung über die Abrechnung bis hin zu Zahlungen der nächsten Generation. Denn wir sind davon überzeugt: Das Gesundheitswesen sollte weniger mit Papierkram und mehr mit Menschen zu tun haben.
Warum? Europa ist mit einem massiven Mangel an medizinischen Fachkräften konfrontiert. Wenn wir die Arbeitsweise von Praxen nicht überdenken, wird das System nicht mithalten können. Mit unserer Series B Finanzierung in Höhe von über 50 Millionen Euro von Weltklasse-Investoren setzen wir unsere Vision in die Tat um.
Was dich erwartet: Wir arbeiten mit dem besten Team und geben gemeinsam jeden Tag alles. Wir setzen auf Talent Density, weil außergewöhnliche Menschen alle um sie herum besser machen. Bei Nelly bewegen wir uns schnell und erwarten, dass alle mithalten. Stillstand ist keine Option, deshalb investieren wir stark in Weiterentwicklung.

KI ist bei uns kein Nice-to-have. Wir erwarten, dass du sie täglich nutzt und geben dir alle Möglichkeiten, dies zu tun. Du bekommst Vertrauen und Verantwortung, dafür erwarten wir, dass du Dinge ansprichst, auch wenn es unbequem ist.

Du bist zentrale Schnittstelle zwischen Produkt, Vertrieb und Technik und sorgst dafür, dass unsere Kunden mit einem perfekten Start in die Zusammenarbeit mit Nelly durchstarten.
Du führst Implementierungsprojekte von A bis Z: von der technischen Integration über den Produktaufbau bis zur Schulung der Praxisteams (vor Ort & online) und der aktiven Nachbetreuung in der Hypercare-Phase (~30 Tage).
Du erkennst Risiken und Probleme im Projektverlauf frühzeitig, sprichst sie aktiv an und bringst eigene Lösungsideen ein.
Du planst, koordinierst und priorisierst deine Aufgaben eigenständig und sorgst so für einen reibungslosen Projektverlauf – auch wenn du mehrere Projekte parallel betreust.

Erste Erfahrung im Projektmanagement oder in der Kundenbetreuung – und echte Lust, noch mehr Verantwortung zu übernehmen.
Proaktivität ist für dich selbstverständlich: du denkst mit, fragst nach und gehst Herausforderungen lösungsorientiert an.
Starke Kommunikation in Wort und Schrift – ob du 5 oder 40 Personen schulst, du trittst sicher und überzeugend auf.
Strukturiertes Selbst- und Zeitmanagement: du organisierst dich eigenständig, auch wenn viele Projekte gleichzeitig laufen.
Hohes Verantwortungsbewusstsein – insbesondere im Umgang mit sensiblen Kunden-, Zahlungs- und Patientendaten.
Flexibilität und Reisebereitschaft (regional, Baden-Württemberg); Führerschein Klasse B.
Teamorientiertes Arbeiten – deine Kolleg:innen können sich auf dich verlassen.

# **Chef de projets industrialisation (H/F) H/F** #
## Description du client ##
Flexsis accompagne les talents en Suisse en leur proposant des opportunités en adéquation avec leurs compétences et leur expérience. Grâce à une approche humaine, exigeante et à des outils digitaux performants, nous valorisons chaque parcours et facilitons l'intégration des candidates et candidats au sein d'équipes dynamiques, engagées et attachées à l'excellence.
Dans le cadre de ses activités de développement, notre client, entreprise de renom basée dans la région biennoise et spécialisée dans la production horlogère, recherche un Chargé de projet industrialisation (H/F) pour un poste fixe.
## Description du poste ##
Dans cette fonction, vous jouez un rôle central dans le passage des projets de développement à la production série. Vous définissez les process de fabrication pour les projets d'industrialisation en vous assurant de leur conformité avec les standards internes, les exigences qualité et les objectifs de performance attendus.
Vous analysez les besoins de production, les contraintes techniques ainsi que les flux de fabrication afin de proposer des méthodes industrielles robustes, fiables et adaptées à l'environnement horloger. Vous participez à la sélection des moyens de production, à la formalisation des gammes opératoires et à la mise en place des paramètres nécessaires au bon déroulement des opérations.
Vous êtes également responsable de l'estimation des temps de fabrication et de la validation de la performance des process en termes de prix, de qualité et de délai. À ce titre, vous contribuez à sécuriser les objectifs industriels et à anticiper les éventuels écarts de performance.
Vous suivez les phases de présérie afin de vous assurer du bon fonctionnement des process définis, de leur stabilité et de leur robustesse en conditions réelles de production. Vous identifiez les axes d'amélioration, pilotez les ajustements nécessaires et coordonnez les actions correctives avec les différents interlocuteurs concernés.
En parallèle, vous animez et coordonnez les équipes impliquées tout au long de la phase de production. Vous veillez à la bonne circulation des informations, à la priorisation des actions et au suivi rigoureux des rectifications à mettre en œuvre. Vous jouez un véritable rôle de liaison entre les équipes techniques, la production, la qualité et les autres services partenaires.
Par votre implication, vous garantissez la cohérence industrielle des projets confiés, tout en assurant un accompagnement structuré jusqu'à la mise en production optimale.
## Profil recherché ##
Vous êtes titulaire d'une formation de Technicien ET ou d'un titre jugé équivalent. Vous justifiez d'une expérience réussie dans une fonction similaire, idéalement en tant que chef de projets industrialisation, au sein d'un environnement industriel exigeant.
Vous possédez de très bonnes connaissances de la fabrication et des produits mécaniques horlogers. Vous maîtrisez les enjeux liés à l'industrialisation, à l'optimisation des processus, à l'analyse des temps de production et au suivi de performance. Une bonne compréhension des problématiques qualité, coûts et délais constitue un atout essentiel pour réussir dans cette fonction.
Vous êtes reconnu pour votre esprit d'initiative, votre sens de l'organisation et votre rigueur. Vous savez gérer plusieurs sujets en parallèle, structurer vos priorités et avancer avec méthode dans un environnement où la précision est primordiale.
Doté d'un excellent sens de la communication, vous appréciez le travail en équipe et savez collaborer avec des interlocuteurs variés. Votre facilité d'adaptation vous permet d'évoluer efficacement au sein d'un contexte technique et dynamique, tout en trouvant rapidement des solutions concrètes face aux imprévus.
Nous vous offrons un cadre de travail moderne et dynamique, des conditions attractives ainsi qu'un accueil et un suivi personnalisé de votre dossier en toute confidentialité.

#### Façonnez avec nous aujourd-hui l-approvisionnement énergétique de demain. ####
Vous souhaitez diriger des projets passionnants de manière autonome, conseiller les clients et mettre en œuvre avec succès des solutions énergétiques innovantes ? Alors vous êtes au bon endroit chez nous.

Chez nous, vous accompagnez les projets de la première idée jusqu-à la mise en œuvre réussie - en particulier les regroupements pour l-autoconsommation (ZEV) au sein desquels vous réalisez également des infrastructures de recharge, des solutions de contracting ainsi que des systèmes intelligents de mesure et de facturation.
## Ce qui vous attend chez nous ##
* Vous conseillez et accompagnez nos clientes et clients ainsi que les investisseurs, planificateurs, électriciens et installateurs solaires dans les domaines du ZEV, de la mobilité électrique, du contracting, ainsi que de la facturation de la chaleur et de l-eau (selon VEWA).

* Vous dirigez des projets exigeants et coordonnez tous les intervenants - de la planification à la mise en service réussie.
* Vous vérifiez les concepts de mesure, accompagnez les chantiers et assurez une mise en œuvre économique et dans les délais.
* Vous mettez en service les installations et systèmes et garantissez une remise sans accroc à l-exploitation.
* Vous soutenez l-exploitation en cours pour les questions techniques et assurez une haute qualité de nos solutions.
* Vous apportez vos idées et développez continuellement avec l-équipe nos processus, services et produits - en particulier pour les solutions dans le domaine de la chaleur et de l-eau.
## Ce que vous apportez ##
* Vous disposez d-une formation technique de base, idéalement dans le domaine de l-électrotechnique, du bâtiment ou de l-énergie.
* Une formation complémentaire de niveau HF/FH ou une qualification comparable est un avantage.

* Vous avez de l-expérience dans la gestion de projets techniques et appréciez le contact direct avec les clients.
* Idéalement, vous avez des connaissances dans les domaines du ZEV, de la mobilité électrique, du comptage intelligent ou des services énergétiques.
* Vous travaillez de manière autonome, précise et orientée solutions, gardez une vue d-ensemble même avec plusieurs projets et pensez de manière entrepreneuriale.
* Vous convainquez par votre aisance en communication, votre sens de la négociation et une présentation assurée.
* Vous possédez d-excellentes connaissances en allemand à l-oral et à l-écrit.
* Vous êtes titulaire du permis de conduire catégorie B.
## Et quoi d-autre ? ##
Chez nous, vous trouverez une tâche variée avec beaucoup de responsabilités et de marge de manœuvre. Vous travaillez sur des projets passionnants autour de la transition énergétique et contribuez activement à l-avenir énergétique avec des services énergétiques innovants.

Vous rejoignez une équipe motivée avec des processus décisionnels courts et une collaboration ouverte et collégiale. Des outils de travail modernes, des formes de travail flexibles et des conditions d-emploi attractives créent un environnement dans lequel vous pouvez vous sentir bien et apporter vos idées.

En même temps, nous vous offrons de nombreuses possibilités de développement professionnel et personnel.

BASIC REQUIREMENT: You must meet both the Basic Requirement and the Specialized Experience to qualify for this series as described below. Degree: Engineering.

To be acceptable, the program must: (1) lead to a bachelor's degree in a school of engineering with at least one program accredited by ABET; or (2) include differential and integral calculus and courses (more advanced than first-year physics and chemistry) in five of the following seven areas of engineering science or physics: (a) statics, dynamics; (b) strength of materials (stress-strain relationships); (c) fluid mechanics, hydraulics; (d) thermodynamics; (e) electrical fields and circuits; (f) nature and properties of materials (relating particle and aggregate structure to properties); and (g) any other comparable area of fundamental engineering science or physics, such as optics, heat transfer, soil mechanics, or electronics.

OR Combination of education and experience -- college-level education, training, and/or technical experience that furnished (1) a thorough knowledge of the physical and mathematical sciences underlying engineering, and (2) a good understanding, both theoretical and practical, of the engineering sciences and techniques and their applications to one of the branches of engineering.

The adequacy of such background must be demonstrated by one of the following: Professional registration or licensure -- Current registration as an Engineer Intern (EI), Engineer in Training (EIT)1, or licensure as a Professional Engineer (PE) by any State, the District of Columbia, Guam, or Puerto Rico.

Absent other means of qualifying under this standard, those applicants who achieved such registration by means other than written test (e.g., State grandfather or eminence provisions) are eligible only for positions that are within or closely related to the specialty field of their registration.

For example, an applicant who attains registration through a State Board's eminence provision as a manufacturing engineer typically would be rated eligible only for manufacturing engineering positions.

Written Test -- Evidence of having successfully passed the Fundamentals of Engineering (FE)2 examination or any other written test required for professional registration by an engineering licensure board in the various States, the District of Columbia, Guam, and Puerto Rico.

Specified academic courses -- Successful completion of at least 60 semester hours of courses in the physical, mathematical, and engineering sciences and that included the courses specified in the basic requirements under paragraph A.

The courses must be fully acceptable toward meeting the requirements of an engineering program as described in paragraph A.

Related curriculum -- Successful completion of a curriculum leading to a bachelor's degree in an appropriate scientific field, e.g., engineering technology, physics, chemistry, architecture, computer science, mathematics, hydrology, or geology, may be accepted in lieu of a bachelor's degree in engineering, provided the applicant has had at least 1 year of professional engineering experience acquired under professional engineering supervision and guidance.

Ordinarily there should be either an established plan of intensive training to develop professional engineering competence, or several years of prior professional engineering-type experience, e.g., in interdisciplinary positions.

(The above examples of related curricula are not all-inclusive.) GS-12 SPECIALIZED EXPERIENCE REQUIREMENTS: A qualified candidate's online application and resume must demonstrate at least one year of specialized experience equivalent to the next lower grade level GS-11 in the Federal service.

Analyzing and evaluating research project results from diverse sources (e.g., industry, academia, national laboratories) to ensure alignment with strategic goals and make informed recommendations.

Preparing and presenting comprehensive technical findings, project statuses, and recommendations to varied audiences, including senior leadership and external stakeholders, to influence decision-making.

GS-13 SPECIALIZED EXPERIENCE REQUIREMENTS: A qualified candidate's online application and resume must demonstrate at least one year of specialized experience equivalent to the next lower grade level GS-12 in the Federal service.

Specialized experience for this position is defined as meeting all of the following: Leading and managing complex scientific or engineering projects or programs from conception to completion, including defining scope, planning resources, monitoring progress, managing budgets, and evaluating outcomes.

Applying engineering or physical science principles, theories, and methods to oversee the technical aspects of projects, ensuring adherence to established standards, policies, and regulations.

Conducting in-depth technical analysis and evaluation of scientific or engineering issues, identifying problems, developing innovative solutions, and making recommendations to resolve complex technical conflicts or uncertainties. "Experience" refers to paid and unpaid experience.

Das Personalamt des Kantons Zürich ist zuständig für alle personal-, arbeits- und sozialversicherungsrechtlichen Fragen der über 30'000 Mitarbeitenden des Kantons Zürich. Die Abteilung Human Resources Management (HRM) beinhaltet eine grosse Anzahl an Aufgaben und ist Teil des Personalamts. HR-Beratung, Berufliche Grundbildung, Employer Branding und Case Management stehen im Mittelpunkt der Arbeit.
**Berufliche Grundbildung bedeutet Zukunft gestalten.**
Jedes Jahr starten rund hundert Lernende in 25 Lehrberufen ihre Ausbildung beim Kanton Zürich. Hinter jeder Lehrstelle steht die Chance, Jugendliche auf ihrem Weg ins Berufsleben zu begleiten und gleichzeitig die Fachkräfte von morgen auszubilden.
Die Berufliche Grundbildung im Personalamt ist zusammen mit dem Berufsbildungsforum für die strategische Ausrichtung und Weiterentwicklung der Berufsbildung im Kanton Zürich zuständig - von der Definition von Standards und Prozessen, der Weiterentwicklung des Lehrstellenangebotes sowie gemeinsamen Projekten und Veranstaltungen.

Gemeinsam schaffen wir die Grundlagen dafür, dass der Kanton Zürich seine Vorbildrolle in der Berufsbildung weiter ausbaut und auch künftig attraktive Perspektiven für junge Menschen bietet.
Diese neu geschaffene Funktion bietet dir die einmalige Möglichkeit, die Berufsbildung in der kantonalen Verwaltung strategisch weiterzuentwickeln. Gemeinsam entwickeln wir eine direktionsübergreifende Strategie und Konzepte, schaffen neue Perspektiven und prägen die Nachwuchsförderung des grössten Arbeitgebers im Kanton Zürich. Die Stelle ist im Rahmen eines Projekts bis Ende 2029 befristet.
### Wie kannst du dich einbringen? ###
* Strategien entwickeln: Gemeinsam mit den Direktionen und Fachbereichen entstehen Konzepte und Strategien (u.a. Lehrstellenförderung, Aufbau der SOG\[AB4.1\], Weiterbeschäftigung von Lehrabgänger/innen, Lehrbetriebsverbundmodelle sowie Lehrberufsverantwortliche) für die Weiterentwicklung der Berufsbildung in der kantonalen Verwaltung.
* Projekte zum Erfolg führen: Von der Idee über die Roadmap bis zur Umsetzung verantwortest du anspruchsvolle Projekte und sorgst dafür, dass aus Konzepten konkrete Ergebnisse werden.
* Netzwerke aufbauen: Du arbeitest direktionsübergreifend mit verschiedenen Anspruchsgruppen zusammen, berücksichtigst unterschiedliche Interessen, präsentierst Lösungsansätze
* Entscheidungsgrundlagen schaffen: Analysen, Trends und deine Handlungsempfehlungen bilden die Basis für strategische Entscheide und die Weiterentwicklung der Berufsbildung.
* Berufsbildung weiterdenken: Du erkennst Chancen für neue Ausbildungsmodelle, stärkst bestehende Angebote und entwickelst nachhaltige Lösungen, damit der Kanton Zürich auch künftig attraktive Perspektiven für junge Menschen bietet.
### Wer bist du? ###
* Berufsbildung begeistert dich: Du kennst die berufliche Grundbildung aus eigener beruflicher Erfahrung und möchtest sie aktiv mitgestalten.
* Strategisch denken. Praktisch umsetzen: Du entwickelst tragfähige Konzepte und verlierst dabei nie die Umsetzung aus den Augen.
* Menschen verbinden: Unterschiedliche Interessen bringst du zusammen und überzeugst durch Klarheit, Diplomatie und ein sicheres Auftreten - auch in einem politischen Umfeld.
### Was bieten wir dir? ###
* Zukunft gestalten: Mit deiner Arbeit entwickelst du die Berufsbildung des grössten Arbeitgebers im Kanton Zürich weiter und hinterlässt nachhaltige Spuren.
* Viel Gestaltungsspielraum: Dich erwartet eine neu geschaffene Funktion mit hoher Eigenverantwortung, spannenden Stakeholdern und der Möglichkeit, die Berufsbildung aktiv mitzugestalten.
